hints.title: Track Value Counts
hints.text: Build a frequency map of all integers in the array.

hints.title: Check Neighboring Values
hints.text: A number x is lonely if count[x] == 1 and neither x - 1 nor x + 1 exists in the map.

hints.title: Collect and Return
hints.text: Iterate through the keys of the frequency map and collect numbers meeting both criteria.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or optimal algorithmic traversal
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear scanning for neighbor existence for every element yields O(N^2) complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash table frequency counting runs in O(N) time with O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Constant-time neighbor verification using hash map lookups.
